title: First Journey PHOTO to mood-direction candidates with strict visual quality gate
prompt: Treat the user's supplied First Journey/Judy reference boards and the following recovered UX rule as a STRICT product contract, not loose inspiration. PHOTO is the top Character Identity authority. The CHARACTER consultation MUST NOT classify the child into fixed personality types and MUST NOT use a fixed LIVELY/WARM/CALM 3-way model. Instead show a varied pool of playful MOOD TILES that represent desired expression/direction. Example tile vocabulary/directions: 신나! = 활발·씩씩·장난꾸러기; 두근두근 = 호기심·모험·발견; 포근해 = 따뜻·친근·다정; 멋져! = 자신감·당당·용감; 집중! = 차분·똑똑·꼼꼼; 상상중 = 신비·창의·이야기. The child selects THREE mood tiles with deliberately large emotional distance between them; optional small keywords can refine each selected direction. Tile choice is DIRECTION, never Identity. The reference photo remains Identity authority regardless of tile choice. Generation sequence/contract: PHOTO identity fixed -> mood tile A -> candidate 1 -> mood tile B -> candidate 2 -> mood tile C -> candidate 3 -> compare set -> choose preferred direction -> resemblance refinement against original PHOTO -> final Character Master. Each of the 3 generation calls must have a distinct explicit purpose so outputs are not three near-duplicates. Candidate 1/2/3 must look like the SAME CHILD at the SAME quality level, but differ strongly at first glance in expression, pose, energy, props, staging and atmosphere according to their selected mood direction. Example only: energy-type playful/dynamic; warm/emotional gentle/bright; adventure-type brave/confident/mysterious explorer. Do not hard-code those three examples as the only choices. UI should support expanding mood-tile vocabulary without changing the core data structure: MOOD_TILE -> KEYWORDS -> PROMPT_DIRECTION. Preserve PHOTO -> CHARACTER consultation -> sequential 3 candidates -> set comparison -> CONFIRM -> resemblance refinement -> COMPLETE/Character Master. Visual quality bar: polished premium child-friendly Ready & Set mobile UI; coherent pale sky-blue world; strong navy/blue typography hierarchy; rounded white cards; deliberate spacing; large clean touch targets; consistent mascot/speech-bubble support; high-quality dimensional animated-film-like child explorer; stable face/hair/outfit identity; coherent explorer outfit/accessories; final selected character suitable for front/side/back, expressions and action reuse. Add/strengthen gates for REFERENCE_COVERAGE, UI_LAYOUT, MOOD_DIRECTION_DISTANCE, CHARACTER_IDENTITY, CHARACTER_RENDER_QUALITY, CROSS_VIEW_CONSISTENCY, MOBILE_RESPONSIVE, SIDE_BY_SIDE_REVIEW. Reject fixed personality classification, near-duplicate candidates, different-child candidates, placeholder art, emoji/icon substitutes as final art, flat low-detail cartoons, distorted anatomy/hands/eyes, inconsistent face/hair/outfit, low-resolution/cropped outputs, generic unrelated children, weak resemblance, and material reference-layout drift. Do not claim visual PASS from static markers alone. Do not call paid image generation or spend credits; stop at the paid-generation approval gate. Work only on Ready isolated work branch; no main/prod merge/deployment/release/location tracking and no Snap growth/badges/Wish Shop migration. Run bounded syntax/static/regression checks and report automated gates separately from runtime/generated-output gates.
